page.layout: Single column of running text with a marginal note in the left margin beside the line "inter dictione". Above the column, the summary line "Quod similiter admittendum.) Sequitur" with "Ne successione.)" in the column itself.

main_text.p: Quod similiter admittendum.) Sequitur 3. Quod de mortuo filio Aquilius scripsit, id etiam ad filium & nepotem, dum modo prius nepos moriatur, recte accommodatur.
Ne successione.) Seq. 4. Prioribus mortuis, insequentes in eorum locum succedunt, & praeteriti testamentum rumpunt.
main_text.head: ARGUMENTUM
main_text.p: Quod de morte Aquilius dixit, id etiam in emancipatione, deportatione & captivitate valet. Sed ne tam multa supplenda sint, cautius erit dicere: Quicunque natus fuerit, si suus nascetur.

»Et quid si tantum in mortis filij casum cociperet? quid Inter dictionē patetur.{*}enim, si aquae & ignis inter dictione peteretur? quid si nepos, ex quo pronepos instituetur, ut ostendimus, emancipatus esset? hi enim casus, & »omnes ex quibus suus heres »post mortem scilicet aut nasce-

page.notes: The left-margin note "Inter dictionē patetur." is set beside the text word "inter", which is marked with an asterisk in the text. Passage ends mid-word "fce-" at the foot of the page, as printed. The running head is partly unreadable. Some letters are doubtful: "aui" (possibly "aut") is marked as printed, and "Quicūq;" is copied as printed. Long s is printed as f in several words (e.g. "fuus", "fcilicet"); these were normalised to s. Several marks at line starts are printed quotation marks (») and are kept.
